# FLX-3121: a generator plugin returned values its expose does not accept

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

The engine asks a plugin for the columns it generates, for rows start to stop, and checks what comes back before any of it is written: one list per requested column, each as long as the range, and every value against its column: its type, its nullability, its declared range, its length and its levels, and the contract's checks, which the engine holds on every row it covers. It refuses the first failure, naming the plugin, the column and the row, and repairs nothing. The message never quotes a value. A plugin that raises is refused the same way, by the name of the error. Correct the plugin, or the declaration the plugin is held to.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3121
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
